description.narrative:
Violet code 1 20k 2025 Proposed Types of Community InitiativesThe initiatives we aim to support in Damascus, Aleppo, Latakia, Hama, and Homs encompass a diverse of activities focusing on improving quality of life and enhancing social bonds, including:
Environmental Cleanup Initiatives
o Cleaning streets and removing sand barriers. o Clearing garbage and stagnant water poses health risks. o Cleaning and improving public spaces such as parks and markets.
Beautification and Rehabilitation Initiatives
o Decorating streets and squares with murals and designs reflecting local culture. o Renovating old buildings and damaged walls to restore their aesthetic appeal. o Planting trees and flowers in public spaces to beautify the environment.
Community Cohesion Initiatives
o Organizing community events such as workshops, sports, and cultural activities that bring together people from various backgrounds. o Providing awareness sessions for children and adults about the importance of cooperation and social harmony. o Organizing recreational activities for children to alleviate trauma and foster positive engagement with their peers.
